newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Maury County, Tenn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Maury County, Tenn.

text.p: OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
Maury County, Tennessee
General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997
SEALED BIDS will be received until 11:00 o'clock A.M.,
C.D.T., on
at Office of Accounts and Budgets, One Courthouse Square, Columbia, Tennessee, at a rate or rates not exceeding 6% per
annum. The Bonds shall be issued in book-entry form as fully
registered bonds (principal and interest), in the name of
Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New
York, New York (
DTC''), as owner of the Bonds,
and immobilized in the custody of DTC. The Bonds will be
dated June 1, 1997, and will mature on June 1 of each of the
years 1998 to 2007, inclusive. No bid will be considered for
less than 99.5 percent of par and the Bonds will be awarded on the basis of the lowest true interest rate, to be
calculated as that rate which, when used in computing the
present worth of all payments of principal and interest to
be paid on the Bonds (compounded semiannually), produces an
amount on the date of the Bonds equal to the purchase price
exclusive of accrued interest.
The Bonds are callable June 1, 2003 and thereafter in the manner provided in the detailed notice of sale. The

approving opinion of Chapman and Cutler will be furnished at the expense of the County. The official statement in near final form which includes the detailed notice of sale may be obtained from the undersigned at Office of Accounts and Budgets, One Courthouse Square, Columbia, Tennessee 38401 or from First Tennessee Bank, National Association, Memphis, Tennessee, the County's Financial Advisor. The Financial Advisor will arrange with the winning bidder promptly after the sale for the preparation at the expense of the County of up to 200 copies of a final official statement.
/s/ Edward C. Harlan
County Executive
(From The Bond Buyer)
